n it. Provide **either** `--suite` **or** `--file`, not both.\n\nBy default the command prints a launch receipt and returns immedi
ately. `--wait` polls every launched run to a terminal state.\n\n**Exit codes (`--wait` only).** Without `--wait` this command's e
xit code is unchanged: `0` on any launch, `1` on a partial or wholly failed fan-out. `--wait` owns a separate six-code contract; a

caller who asked this process to sit and watch a run to completion is asking it to say how the run went:

| Code | Meaning |
|
- | - |\n| `0` | Every waited run passed, unanimously, and (when a report was requested) every report was assembled |\n| `1` | A
run **completed** with a **failed** verdict. The only condition that produces this code |\n| `2` | Usage error: bad flags, `--repo
rter`/`--out` without `--wait`, or an invalid suite file (after auth, before any server/model work) |\n| `3` | Auth failed: no cre
dential, or the platform rejected it, at launch or mid-wait (a token that expired during a long poll). Zero credits spent if it ha
ppened before launch |\n| `4` | Connection/setup failed before evaluation: a launch failure this CLI itself observed (network, tim
eout, rate limit, a partial or failed fan-out, an unrecognized launch error), or a local `--out` write failure, unless a more seve
re outcome (`1` or `3`) already applies to the same run, per the merge order above |\n| `5` | No valid verdict: `inconclusive`, a
null/unrecognized result, a run whose own status is failed/cancelled/timed-out, a wait that hit its deadline, a mid-wait failure t
hat was not auth-shaped, or a report that could not be assembled |\n\nNo infrastructure condition ever maps to `1`; see the same r
ule under `eval gate` below. A multi-target launch merges these worst-of across every waited run, in the order `1 > 3 > 4 > 5 > 0`
: a real verdict failure is never masked by a sibling's infrastructure noise, and a credential failure (which may be *why* other t
argets show no verdict) outranks a plain connection failure.\n\nThis six-code contract is new and deliberately **different** from
`eval gate`'s four codes below; see that command's own doc for why the two are not unified. An invalid suite file exits **2** eith
er way; `eval validate` still exits 1 for the same contract failure, because it is a verdict on the file and this command is not.\

n
| Flag | Required | Description |
| - | - | - |
| `--suite <id-or-name>` | Yes, unless `--file` | Eval suite name or ID |
|
`--file <path>` | Yes, unless `--suite` | Versioned suite file to upload and run (`.yaml` or `.json`, or `-` for stdin) |\n| `--pr
oject <id-or-name>` | No | Project name or ID (defaults to the most recently updated project) |\n| `--server <id-or-name...>` | No
| Override the suite's saved server selection (HTTP servers only) |\n| `--environment <id-or-name...>` | No | Attached project en
vironment(s) to run. Several values start one **paid run each**. |\n| `--client <id-or-name...>` | No | Attached client(s) to run,
so the run is stamped with that client's config. Several values start one **paid run each**. |\n| `--host <id-or-name...>` | No |
**Deprecated** alias for `--client`. Passing both is an error. Not the host-compat catalog id `mcpjam compat --host` / `mcpjam to
ols --host` take: see [Two different `--host` flags](#two-different---host-flags). |\n| `--all-targets` | No | Run **every** attac
hed environment (or, if none, every attached host): one **paid run per target** |\n| `--iterations <n>` | No | Run each case this
many times (1-10), for this run only |\n| `--repetitions <n>` | No | **Legacy** spelling of `--iterations`. Passing both is an err
or. |\n| `--case <id-or-title...>` | No | Run only these cases instead of the whole suite |\n| `--refresh-snapshot` | No | **Persi
sts a new host-config snapshot on the suite** (see below). Single-target runs only. |\n| `--notes <text>` | No | Free-text note st
ored on the run |\n| `--min-pass-rate <n>` | No | Pass threshold for this run (0-100), overriding the suite's own |\n| `--match-op
tions <json>` | No | Tool-call match options for this run, e.g. `'{\"toolCallOrder\":\"exact\"}'` |\n| `--idempotency-key <key>` |
No | Retry key for a lost launch response. For `--file`, a fresh key is minted and printed on every invocation when this flag is
omitted; supply the printed key to replay the same run instead of starting a new one |\n| `--wait` | No | Wait for every launched
run to reach a terminal status |\n| `--wait-timeout <ms>` | No | Maximum wait time (default 2100000); requires `--wait` |\n| `--re
porter <json-summary\\|junit-xml\\|html>` | No | Write the completed structured report to stdout; requires `--wait`. `html` is a s
elf-contained decision summary + failures page: traces/parity/history are not included. |\n| `--out <path>` | No | Atomically writ
e the completed report to a file; defaults to `json-summary`, or uses `--reporter` when present; requires `--wait` |\n| `--compose
-client <id-or-name>` | No | Compose a stack to run instead of naming a saved environment (see below). **Ephemeral by default**: p
ass `--save-targets` to attach it to the suite. |\n| `--compose-host <id-or-name>` | No | **Deprecated** alias for `--compose-clie
nt` |\n| `--compose-model <id...>` | No | Model(s) to run on the composed stack. Replaces the client's pinned model unless `--with
-client-default` is set |\n| `--compose-model-selection <json...>` | No | Whole saved model selection(s) (source, connection, `set
tings.reasoningEffort`) as JSON: one cell per selection, for its model, at its effort. Repeat to add several selections for one mo
del (e.g. at low and at high); each distinct selection is its own cell |\n| `--with-client-default` | No | Also launch an inherit
cell using each client's pinned model, alongside `--compose-model` |\n| `--compose-server <id-or-name...>` | No | Server(s) to pin
on the composed stack, snapshotted into a server group so a rerun keeps testing them. Mutually exclusive with `--compose-server-g
roup` |\n| `--compose-server-group <id>` | No | Standalone server group to pin on the composed stack |\n| `--compose-host-servers`
| No | **No longer supported**: rejected. An eval run takes its servers from a server group alone; use `--compose-server` or `--c
